key.name: fade-text-on-fullscreen
key.description: If enabled, the top bar text will fade when an application is fullscreen

key.name: text-fade-opacity
key.description: Opacity level for text and icons when faded (0.0 = fully transparent, 1.0 = fully opaque)

key.name: text-fade-color
key.description: Color for text and icons when faded

key.name: background-fade-opacity
key.description: Opacity level for the top bar background when transparent (0.0 = fully transparent, 1.0 = fully opaque)

key.name: osd-opacity
key.description: Background opacity for the on-screen display (volume, brightness, etc.)

key.name: osd-text-opacity
key.description: Opacity for the OSD icon, logo, and text

key.name: osd-text-color
key.description: Color for the OSD icon, logo, and text
